profile.meaning: CPU and rolling stream bytes are telemetry, not admission ceilings. Actual resident-memory, host-memory, disk, queue, information and protection deadlines remain enforced; owned financial management continues.

dropIn:
# Reviewed drop-in for the EXISTING authoritative poe-runtime.service only.
# /etc/systemd/system/poe-runtime.service.d/90-native-engine.conf
# Original User/Group/EnvironmentFile/LoadCredential and account remain intact.
[Unit]
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B -I /opt/poe/current/operator/native-paper-ec2/run-authoritative-service.py
# The obsolete observer IPC command must not run against the new source.
# SIGTERM to the main supervisor checkpoints its sole financial child first.
ExecStop=
KillMode=mixed
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStopSec=60
LimitCPU=infinity
LimitFSIZE=infinity
LimitCORE=0
LimitNOFILE=256
Nice=0
CPUWeight=100
CPUQuota=
CPUQuotaPeriodSec=100ms
MemoryHigh=2560M
MemoryMax=3072M
MemorySwapMax=0
TasksMax=64
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/poe /run/poe -/var/lib/poe-public
UMask=0077
note: Final app policy fields include continuous adaptive diagnostics; root should recompute configuration after all concurrent work is frozen
